title: Diorganotin(IV) complexes based on tridentate ONO ligands as potential anticancer agents.
authors: Jiang, Wujiu; Qin, Qiqi; Xiao, Xiyuan; Tan, Yuxing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究有机锡配合物的合成及其抗癌活性，虽含DNA结合与分子对接，但对象为小分子-核酸互作而非蛋白质-DNA体系，方法仅简单对接，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Eight new diorganotin(IV) complexes (1a-2d), namely [X-C(6)H(4)(O)C=N-N=C(Me)COO]R(2)Sn(CH(3)OH)(n) (1a, 2a), [X-C(6)H(4)(O)C=N-N=C(Me)COO]R(2)Sn(CH(3)OH)(2) (1b, 1c, 1d, 2b), and [X-C(6)H(4)(O)C=N-N=C(Me)COO]R(2)Sn(2) (2c, 2d) (X = H-, p-Me-, p-OH-, p-NO(2)-; R = o-Cl-C(6)H(4)CH(2)- or o-Me-C(6)H(4)CH(2)-), have been synthesized by microwave "one-pot" reaction with arylformylhydrazine, pyruvic acid, and the corresponding R(2)SnCl(2). All the complexes have been characterized by FT-IR (Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy), multinuclear NMR ((1)H, (13)C, and (119)Sn nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopies), HRMS (high-resolution mass spectroscopy) and single-crystal X-ray structural analysis. The antiproliferative activity of all complexes was tested against the cancer cell lines NCI-H460, MCF-7 and HepG2. The diorganotin complex 1c has been shown to be more potent antitumor agents against HepG2 than other complexes and cisplatin. Flow cytometry analysis observation demonstrated that complex 1c mediated cell apoptosis of HepG2 cells and arrested cell cycle in the S phase. The single cell gel electrophoreses assay results show that the 1c induce DNA damage. The DNA binding activities of the 1c were studied by UV-visible absorption spectrometry, fluorescence competitive, circular dichroism measurements, and molecular docking, results shown 1c can be well embedded in the groove and cleave DNA.
abstract_zh: 通过微波“一锅法”反应，以芳基甲酰肼、丙酮酸及相应的R(2)SnCl(2)合成了八种新型二有机锡(IV)配合物（1a-2d），即[X-C(6)H(4)(O)C=N-N=C(Me)COO]R(2)Sn(CH(3)OH)(n)（1a, 2a）、[X-C(6)H(4)(O)C=N-N=C(Me)COO]R(2)Sn(CH(3)OH)(2)（1b, 1c, 1d, 2b）和[X-C(6)H(4)(O)C=N-N=C(Me)COO]R(2)Sn(2)（2c, 2d）（其中X = H-、p-Me-、p-OH-、p-NO(2)-；R = o-Cl-C(6)H(4)CH(2)-或o-Me-C(6)H(4)CH(2)-）。所有配合物均通过傅里叶变换红外光谱（FT-IR）、多核核磁共振波谱（(1)H、 (13)C和(119)Sn NMR）、高分辨质谱（HRMS）及单晶X射线结构分析进行了表征。测试了所有配合物对癌细胞系NCI-H460、MCF-7和HepG2的抗增殖活性。结果表明，二有机锡配合物1c对HepG2的抗肿瘤活性优于其他配合物及顺铂。流式细胞术分析观察显示，配合物1c介导HepG2细胞凋亡，并将细胞周期阻滞在S期。单细胞凝胶电泳实验结果表明，1c诱导DNA损伤。通过紫外-可见吸收光谱、荧光竞争、圆二色谱测量及分子对接研究了1c的DNA结合活性，结果显示1c能良好嵌入DNA沟槽并切割DNA。
